text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week wants me to watch her
dance
lessons, so I go and take a look.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's pretty much how it goes...
What'd
you think? Be honest.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! I still feel pretty lost out
there...
choice_data_list: Maybe that was a bit awkward?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So what I'm gonna do is get better at
dancing
until I actually look good doing
it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts are where I can
express my
gratitude to everyone who
supports me, so I
wanna make sure I
dance well!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know this might be weird to ask, but...
do you
know how I can get better at
dancing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know this might be weird to ask, but...
do you
know how I can get better at
dancing?
choice_data_list: Dancing energetically in your own style is best.
The best thing is to dance energetically in your own style.
Dancing in sync with the music is key.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: Dancing energetically in your own style is best.
The best thing is to dance energetically in your own style.
Dancing in sync with the music is key.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense! If I wanna show my
gratitude,
then I've gotta be me out
there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! I'll learn to be more
expressive when I
dance, so I can convey
how thankful I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week lets herself go and focuses
on
moving her whole body for the rest of
her dance
lesson.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right. A janky dance that doesn't
match
the music wouldn't look great,
would it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That means I've really gotta listen to the
song and
make sure I dance along to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Special Week focuses on the
beat and
practices dancing in time with
it.
